name: ado-work-map
description: Self-contained Azure DevOps work map: delivery map, sprints, changes, maps and a spider web of your work and repos, in one offline HTML report.

adoWorkMap.organization.markdownDescription: Your Azure DevOps organization: the part after `https://dev.azure.com/`, e.g. `contoso`. Pasting the whole address (even with the project on the end) works too. For Azure DevOps Server, the collection name.

adoWorkMap.team.markdownDescription: Team whose sprints are shown. Empty = `<project> Team`.

adoWorkMap.iteration.markdownDescription: Treat this iteration path as the current sprint, e.g. `Project\Sprint 14`. Empty = the team's current sprint.

adoWorkMap.epicIds.markdownDescription: Only these epics and everything under them, comma separated, e.g. `1234,5678`.

adoWorkMap.areaPath.description: Only this area path and its children.

adoWorkMap.closedWithinDays.description: Skip items closed more than this many days ago (-1 = keep all). Open items are always kept.

adoWorkMap.includeRemoved.description: Include items in the Removed state.

adoWorkMap.historyDays.description: Days of history to pull from Analytics with Pull History.

adoWorkMap.commitDays.description: Days of commit history for the commit heatmap (0 = off). Only commit dates and authors are read, never code.

adoWorkMap.archiveDays.description: Days to keep the daily report copies (0 = don't archive).

adoWorkMap.maxPrDetails.description: Cap on one-by-one lookups for linked pull requests the PR list doesn't cover.

adoWorkMap.serverUrl.markdownDescription: Change only for Azure DevOps Server (on-premises), e.g. `https://tfs.contoso.com/tfs`.

adoWorkMap.dataFolder.markdownDescription: Where the report, cache and history are kept. Empty = the extension's own storage folder (outside your repos).

adoWorkMap.pullOnStartup.description: Pull changes when VS Code starts.

adoWorkMap.autoPullMinutes.description: Pull changes every N minutes while VS Code is open (0 = off).

enumDescriptions: Open the report in a VS Code tab
Open the report in your default browser
adoWorkMap.openReportIn.description: Where Open Report shows the report.
